SELECT a.`resource_id`,a.`name`,b.start_time,b.end_time,b.count,a.update_time FROM `oj_train_plan` a left join (SELECT min(start_time) start_time,max(end_time) end_time,count(1) count, train_plan_id,max(update_time) update_time FROM oj_classroom group by train_plan_id) b
on a.resource_id = b.train_plan_id where a.create_user_id = #{userId} union SELECT train_plan_id,train_plan_id,min(start_time) start_time,max(end_time) end_time,count(1) count, max(update_time) update_time FROM oj_classroom where train_plan_id = '' and create_user_id = #{userId} group by train_plan_id
